name: liquid_filter
summary: A 4-pole (24 dB/oct) resonant lowpass ladder in the spirit of the Mutable Instruments Ripples / Audible Instruments Liquid Filter. Four one-pole OTA stages with a 4x negative feedback whose soft clip sits on the resonance path (the Ripples OTA, and the SH-101's feedback diodes), so the input stays linear and the self-oscillation amplitude is independent of the input level. `f` (Q16) is the per-stage coefficient, `res`/`comp` the resonance and output compensation, plus `fenv`/`k`/`vk` cutoff modulation and `on` bypass. Outputs `out` (LP4), `lp2` (LP2), `band` (BP tap).
